issues.explanation: In 「叩いたことさえある」, ある expresses that such an event has occurred or that one has had the experience, not simple existence.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en: "have the experience of; have happened".

issues.explanation: In 「押し込んだりする」, する is the lexical verb concluding the 〜たり〜たりする construction, not an auxiliary.
癖 lexically means a habit, tendency, or propensity. The adversative meaning comes from the composite construction 〜くせに.
In 「くせに」, に is a connective particle; “in spite of” is the meaning of the full 〜くせに construction, already represented by the grammar overlay.
In 「無理に割り込んで」, 無理 functions adverbially to mean “forcibly” or “by force,” rather than the standalone noun “force.”
